$comment: Optional enrichment for GitHub projects. Keys under 'overrides' are repo names. 'extra' adds projects that aren't on GitHub. See docs/DATA.md.

CAPIET-StatesThatMatter.title: States that Matter
CAPIET-StatesThatMatter.description: A Unity puzzle-platformer about the states of matter. Players heat, cool, and bond materials to change their phase and get through 15 stages. Built alongside a research paper and prepared for summative playtesting.
highlights: 15 stages covering all six phase changes
Particle-lattice visuals that show what happens to matter as it changes state
Mini-dialogue system, level select, and saved progress
Polished level by level ahead of summative playtesting

LilLycanLordsWorkshopWonders.title: LilLycanLord's Workshop Wonders
LilLycanLordsWorkshopWonders.description: My personal Unity toolkit: reusable systems I bring into new projects, from audio and scene transitions to UI widgets and player movement.
highlights: Audio, beat, scene-transition, game-event, and dialogue managers
UI widgets: health bar, combo and store counters, canvas fader
Billboarding, hoverables, and a general movement system
Pixel View Maker for a pixelated camera look

GDENG01-RenderingShowcase.title: Rendering Showcase
GDENG01-RenderingShowcase.description: A team-built Unity scene showcase for a rendering course: themed rooms connected by teleporters, with baked lighting, PBR materials, water, particles, and post-processing.
highlights: Built the crossfader, scene teleporter, and audio manager
Added water, post-processing, props, and textures
